title: Subscription Cost Hotspot
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monarch:transaction recurring=true
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount_usd) as monthly_cost_usd by merchant _time
| sort - monthly_cost_usd
description: Uses Monarch recurring charges telemetry to monitor which subscriptions cost the most each month in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for services that deserve a renewal review, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Monarch recurring charges data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which subscriptions cost the most each month so you can spot services that deserve a renewal review before it becomes annoying.
